posts.author: Ritter
posts.body:
Introduction​
Does your game suffer from repetitive sound effects? Hearing the same sounds repeatedly can lead to
audio fatigue
for your players, diminishing their overall experience.
With this plugin, you can:
Apply Pitch Shifting
: Add subtle pitch variation to specific sound effects.
Map Alternate Sound Effects
: Replace repetitive sounds with randomly chosen variations. For example, when "Attack1" is played, the plugin can choose a random variation from a mapped list to keep things fresh.
